description: This PHP class file defines the CloudWatchEventsClient class, which is used to interact with the Amazon CloudWatch Events service within the AWS SDK for PHP. The class extends AwsClient and provides method annotations for various CloudWatch Events API operations, both synchronous and asynchronous.

classes.name: CloudWatchEventsClient
classes.description: A client for interacting with AWS CloudWatch Events, providing methods to manage event buses, rules, archives, and other related resources.
